# IconShuffle

> Pull an iPhone home screen into a TOML file, edit it, and push it back safely from Windows, macOS or Linux, over USB or Wi-Fi. The command is `iconshuffle`. Every write is confirmed by the user, backed up, verified and rolled back on failure.

AI agents helping someone rearrange their home screen: read the agent guide first. It covers setup, the layout file rules, the safe edit workflow (check, show the changes, wait for the user's yes, push), JSON output and error codes.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YakupEmreYerli/IconShuffle/main/docs/agent-guide.md): everything an agent needs, in one page
- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YakupEmreYerli/IconShuffle/main/docs/mcp.md): `iconshuffle mcp` for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and VS Code; its tools, setup and demo mode
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YakupEmreYerli/IconShuffle/main/README.md): what the tool does, install and platforms
- [Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YakupEmreYerli/IconShuffle/main/docs/reference.md): every command and option, the layout file and the safety model
- [Example layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YakupEmreYerli/IconShuffle/main/examples/layout.toml): a complete layout file
